subject: Follow-up: pen test fixes and verification for FinApp integration
content:
From: Jared Bloom <jbloom@finapp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: evidence of fixes from recent pentest

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for sending over the penetration test report last week. Our security team reviewed items 1 (SQL injection harvested through legacy analytics endpoint) and 3 (auth bypass in service-to-service token validation) and they want remediation evidence before we clear the integration for production. Specifically, they asked for:

- A short summary of what was changed in each affected component (code/config).
- Ticket IDs or changelogs showing the fix landed and deployed.
- Screenshots or config snippets (Kubernetes networkpolicies, WAF rule entries).
- Sample, sanitized logs showing attempted exploit traffic after the fix (to validate no recurring attempts were successful).
- Any compensating controls (WAF, IPS, monitoring rules) you put in place and their IDs.

Can you provide the above or let me know if you need an NDA/access to view unredacted materials? We need to present this to procurement by EOD next Friday.

-Jared
Security Architect, FinApp
security@finapp.com

-----
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Bloom <jbloom@finapp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: evidence of fixes from recent pentest

Hi Jared —

Appreciate the clear list. Below is a concise package we can share without additional NDAs; anything that requires access to live logs or raw findings we can share under an access agreement or via a screenshared session with Rishi (our security lead). Attached to this email are the items that map to your ask:

1) What changed
- SQL injection (analytics endpoint): input parameterization added, DB layer rewritten to use prepared statements; see commit and diff attached (gitcommit-diff-7f3a2.patch).
- Auth bypass (service token validation): added token expiry enforcement and additional audience checks in the auth middleware; configuration change applied in the service's Helm chart.

2) Tickets / changelogs
- JIRA: SE-4521 — fix and deploy tracked here (link below).
- Attachment: ticket-4521-fix-details.txt contains the deployment window, rollback plan, and verification checklist.

3) Screenshots / config snippets
- Attached: k8s-networkpolicy-screenshot.png (shows the NetworkPolicy restricting traffic to the analytics pod).
- Attached: waf-ruleset-export.json (export of the WAF rule set we applied for the OWASP SQLi signature and an IP denylist).

4) Sample logs
- Attached: access-log-sample-20260218.csv — this is a sanitized extract showing the pre-fix attempts and post-fix activity. We removed any identifiable customer payloads. The post-fix rows show no successful /v1/analytics write attempts with injection payloads.

5) Compensating controls and monitoring
- WAF ruleset ID: WAF-RED-2026-11 (see export).
- IDS alerts routed to our SOC runbook with automatic ticket creation (alerts -> SE-ALERT pipeline).
- Increased retention for auth failure logs to 90 days for this service; retention policy change applied 2026-02-17.

Next steps we propose:
- If the attached artifacts are sufficient, please confirm and we'll mark SE-4521 as closed in the JIRA.
- If you need sanitized raw logs or a short live session to review the fix, Rishi and I can set up a screenshare Thursday or Friday.

I[0m'm copying Rishi for the technical details below.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales (Security Programs)
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0132

-----
From: Jared Bloom <jbloom@finapp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: evidence of fixes from recent pentest

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups from our security team:

- Can you confirm the exact deploy timestamp(s) for the fixes (UTC)? We need to match them to our monitoring windows.
- The sanitized log sample is helpful; could you provide a second slice that shows the same endpoint traffic for two weeks post-deploy? We only received a one-day sample.
- For the code change, can you provide the public commit hash or a way to verify the change happened (we don't need the full repo access, just the commit id and diff).

If we can get those three items this week we'll route to procurement. Otherwise we'll request a short re-test window.

-Jared

-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Bloom <jbloom@finapp.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: evidence of fixes from recent pentest

Hi Jared —

Quick technical addendum to confirm the items Evelyn sent. Deploy timestamps (UTC):
- SQLi fix deployed: 2026-02-17T23:03:00Z (canary), full rollout complete 2026-02-18T02:12:00Z.
- Auth middleware hardening deployed: 2026-02-17T23:48:00Z.

Commit/verification details:
- Public/reproducible commit: 7f3a2b1 (short hash). We attached a patch file (gitcommit-diff-7f3a2.patch) that contains the critical diffs; the full commit in our internal repo references the same hash.

Additional evidence we can provide on request:
- Two-week post-deploy sanitized log slice (we can create a CSV similar to what we attached; includes header metadata but strips request bodies).
- Runtime config dump from the canary instance (we'd prefer screenshare to review unredacted configs).
- A short (10–12 minute) recorded demo showing the NetworkPolicy and WAF rule being applied and the alert firing in our SOC dashboard.

Compensating controls summary:
- WAF: WAF-RED-2026-11 (SQLi signatures and custom rate-limits).
- Network policies: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy applied to analytics namespace limiting egress and ingress to known service accounts.
- Detection: Custom IDS signature (SIG-ANALYTICS-01) added to our IDS rule set that triggers a high-priority ticket to SE-ALERT when matched.

If you prefer, we can package the two-week logs and the recorded demo under an access agreement so you can validate directly with our team. Let me know which option works best and I'll coordinate a time.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

[Attachments: redwood_pt_report_20260128.pdf; ticket-4521-fix-details.txt; k8s-networkpolicy-screenshot.png; waf-ruleset-export.json; access-log-sample-20260218.csv; gitcommit-diff-7f3a2.patch]
